# chameleon_principal_role (Resource)

Manages a Polaris principal role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chameleon_principal_role" "data_reader" {
  name = "data_reader"
  properties = {
    description = "Read-only access across analytics catalogs"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Principal role name.

### Optional

- `properties` (Map of String) Free-form metadata attached to the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Principal role name (used as the Terraform resource ID).
